verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payment gateway, so settlement and payout reconciliation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no payout, settlement or balance-transaction API, and nothing that maps a bank deposit to its underlying charges. The supplier-payments page (kushki-docs-18) covers outbound disbursements to third parties, not settlement reconciliation, and the llms.txt and markdown docs only make the existing docs agent-readable.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
